skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Summer Feast
skins.content: Test Collection Series/Summer Feast. Mizuki wears this when feasting on the beach. The material is stain-resistant and provides plenty of room for extra appendages.
skins.quote: Summer, a party, an uneventful life, a drink in one hand, and a game in the other. What else can be called happiness?

skins.name: A Player Forever
skins.content: Achievement Star Collection/A Player Forever. Outfit Mizuki wears when he plays games in Higashi. A perfect fusion of stylish street fashion and retro game elements, letting Mizuki show off his gamer style at max settings.
skins.quote: Like many other children, the first time Mizuki found a game he liked, his childhood was only just beginning. It was a naive wish, but he too once hoped these simple joys would never end.
